title: 全球波动中：新加坡市场逆势领涨，高估值能否持续？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Singapore stocks have outperformed the world over the past month.
segments.zh: 过去一个月，新加坡市场表现优于全球。

segments.en: Their traditional strengths of high dividend yields and resilient balance sheets have had a lift from what J.P. Morgan describes as a gold delogues economic backdrop.
segments.zh: 其传统优势——高股息率和稳健的资产负债表——因摩根大通所称的“黄金宏观背景”而得到提振。

segments.en: For more, let's bring in our Asia Aquities reporter Benadette Toe and Barn.
segments.zh: 更多详情，我们连线亚洲市场记者贝纳黛特·托。

segments.en: I mean, this is unheard of. We're boring. We're stable.
segments.zh: 这真是前所未有。我们向来乏味，但稳定。

segments.en: But now we're potting. Yes, we are. Singapore's had a really good year.
segments.zh: 但现在我们表现强劲。确实如此，新加坡今年表现很好。

segments.en: It's been having a really good time. It's been really resilient amongst the global volatility in the market, so it's been a favorite amongst a lot of investors.
segments.zh: 一直表现不错，在全球市场波动中展现出韧性，因此受到许多市场参与者青睐。

segments.en: A lot has to do with what you talked about stability in the different factors, including the same dollar as well, right?
segments.zh: 很大程度上与你提到的稳定性有关，包括新加坡元等因素，对吧？

segments.en: Yes, so there are lots of positives going on for Singapore stocks.
segments.zh: 是的，新加坡市场有很多积极因素。

segments.en: One is the high dividend yields which we have mentioned. And also the strong Singapore dollar, which is definitely really appealing to investors.
segments.zh: 一是我们提到的高股息率，还有强劲的新加坡元，这对市场参与者非常有吸引力。

segments.en: But what's also new this time round for Singapore stocks is that there is also capital appreciation there is a growth story that's led by moderated inflation
segments.zh: 但这次新加坡市场的新变化是，还有资本增值，由通胀温和带来的增长故事。

segments.en: and also just good corporate earnings because of the tech exports.
segments.zh: 同时，科技出口带来的企业盈利也很强劲。

segments.en: So that with the dividend play and the growth story is just making Singapore stocks really, really attractive. You talked about good corporate earnings.
segments.zh: 因此，股息回报加上增长故事，让新加坡市场极具吸引力。你提到了强劲的企业盈利。

segments.en: We're seeing that a lot for the banks in particular, not surprising, they're leading the pack up.
segments.zh: 我们看到银行板块尤其突出，不出所料，它们领涨。

segments.en: The question really is whether there's more gains to be had.
segments.zh: 问题在于，是否还有更多上涨空间。
